purpose: Canonical capability routes with an ordered primary skill and explicitly conditional supplements; aliases identify candidates, not installed or trusted tools.
completion_policy: A mandatory route without an available mapped capability blocks implementation or verified completion. Report the gap and request a safe next step; never silently substitute a generic workflow.

routes.selection_rule: Use the first-party product-requirements-grilling skill. No generic interview or hiring skill is an equivalent.

Use imagegen (or an explicitly approved equivalent image-generation capability) for the mockup/edit. nano-banana-pro is an approved equivalent only when installed; taste-skill may guide art direction but cannot replace image generation. Do not use a frontend implementation skill as mockup evidence.

Use review-agent or code-reviewer for a defect-first code review. Use pr-review-expert only when the task specifically requires PR workflow, reviewability, or merge-readiness analysis; it supplements rather than replaces the review report.

Use security-best-practices for supported source-code reviews. Use senior-security for threat modeling or secure architecture and senior-secops for CVE/compliance/infrastructure operations. A conditional specialty does not waive the primary review when the primary applies.

Use playwright for ordinary real-browser interaction and proof. Use agent-browser only when installed and its accessibility-tree/session model is the better fit; use playwright-pro only for test-suite generation, migration, repair, cloud matrix, or test-management work.

Use screenshot for desktop/OS capture. Use Playwright or agent-browser capture only when the claim is inside a browser flow and the captured artifact covers the required viewport and layout boundaries.
Use tdd-guide for unit/behavior tests. Use senior-qa for coverage and application test strategy, api-test-suite-builder for API suites, and playwright-pro for E2E suite operations.
Use release-manager for release readiness and artifact closure. Use ci-cd-pipeline-builder when pipeline design or repair is part of the release work.

Use senior-frontend only after requirements and mockup gates close. Use figma-implement-design when an approved Figma node is the implementation source; it does not replace requirements grilling or mockup approval.
Use skill-security-auditor before installing or trusting an external skill or plugin. General source-code security review is not an equivalent extension-trust audit.

non_default_skill_policy.reason: Its Claude-oriented auto-memory and rule-promotion paths must not automatically write persistent rules or replace project-native AGENTS.md, PROJECT_MAP.md, CODE_MAP.md, or .learnings/ERRORS.md.
Use only for schema-focused work; database-designer remains the default for broader database design so both are not invoked for the same decision.
High-impact tenant administration; never activate from generic engineering routing.
Use only for explicit AWS architecture or migration requests.
